title: Account Executive
description: Account Executive EU GTM | London, United Kingdom About the team Join our high-energy team in London and help us bring smarter payment solutions to growing businesses across the UK and Europe. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower merchants by making payments simple, accessible, and hassle-free. Today, we support over 4 million businesses in 30+ countries — and we're just getting started. As an Account Executive, you'll be part of a collaborative, fast-paced team driving growth and helping business owners with £50k+ in revenue access the tools they need to succeed. What you'll do Proactively identify and reach out to prospects via calls, emails, and social — you'll be the one starting the conversation Build strong relationships by understanding the unique needs of each business and showing how SumUp can make a real difference Go on-site to meet prospects and clients in person — building trust face-to-face and delivering demos that convert Deliver value-driven product pitches and demos that help convert curiosity into commitment Own the full sales cycle — from first outreach to deal closed Track your performance, meet your goals, and continuously level up through feedback and data Share insights, collaborate with your team, and help build an energised outbound culture in the office You'll be great for this role if… You have 1–2 years of outbound sales or business development experience — and a drive to learn and grow fast in the role. You're confident, curious, and comfortable with high-volume outreach (mostly phone-based). You love solving problems and helping people. You're results-driven and thrive on smashing targets. You bring a positive, team-first attitude and enjoy celebrating wins with your colleagues. Bonus: Experience in payment tech, SaaS, or hospitality tools is a big plus. Why you should join SumUp 💸 Competitive base salary + uncapped commission — your earning potential grows with your success! ✅ A foot in the fintech door — work for a global brand that's scaling fast and be part of a mission-driven team with real impact 🏢 Office-first culture in Central London — collaborate face-to-face with a fun, supportive team and stay connected to the energy of live sales 📚 €2,000 annual learning budget — invest in your development with training, events, or courses that support your goals 🧘 Sabbatical after 3 years — take a well-earned 30-day break to reset or pursue something meaningful 🌍 Diverse and inclusive workplace — be part of a team that values different perspectives and creates space for everyone to thrive 🔗 Referral bonus — help grow the team by referring talented friends or former colleagues and get rewarded for it About SumUp Be empowered to do more that matters. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships. Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 4,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify. SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok. title: Senior GNC Engineer
description: As a GNC/AOCS Engineer at Spire, you will operate as part of a technical team who maintains responsibility across the full lifecycle of its engineering products. The GNC team interfaces directly with many engineering groups to conduct R&D, design, manufacturing, and operations activities, ultimately ensuring all current and future spacecraft systems satisfy their mission. Ideal candidates will embrace the commercialization of nanosatellite systems and adapt to low-cost, fast-paced systems design, development, and implementation methodologies that set Spire apart from our competition. In this fast-paced environment, the design to launch cycle is measured in weeks and months, not years! What You'll Do: Technical ownership of current and future spacecraft attitude and orbit control software and hardware. Design, model, analyze, integrate and operate attitude determination/estimation systems for small spacecraft. Develop and utilize spacecraft dynamics and control simulations, including 'hardware-in-the-loop'. Design, evaluate, select, qualify and implement flight sensors, including magnetometers, sun sensors, inertial measurement devices, infrared sensors, and/or star trackers. Design, evaluate, select, qualify and implement flight actuators, including magnetic torque elements, reaction wheels, and propulsion systems. Be hands-on in laboratory and manufacturing environments during testing, integration, and qualification of flight systems. Provide support and analysis for on-orbit operations of spacecraft attitude determination and control systems. Work with external contractors, manufacturers, and internal manufacturing staff to improve reliability, yield, performance, and cost of flight systems. Key Skills: Extensive experience with a solid foundation in spacecraft attitude dynamics and control algorithms, with emphasis on practical application of knowledge. Have experience designing and/or implementing Kalman filters for attitude estimation. Experience with flight sensors for spacecraft attitude determination/estimation. Experience developing software using C/Python. Have experience or familiarity with the Linux development environment. Have experience working with external engineering contractors. Preferred Skills: Experience writing flight software. Experience with C or C++ development for embedded systems. Experience with spacecraft design. Experience with spacecraft assembly, integration, and testing. Experience with spacecraft operations and maintenance. Experience identifying and resolving system anomalies. Experience creating and maintaining integration and test campaigns for attitude determination and control systems, including hardware and software. Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three days per week in the office. Access to US export-controlled software and/or technology may be required for this role. If needed, Spire will arrange the necessary licenses—this is not something candidates need to have before applying. #LI-MI1 Global Perks 🛰️ Name Your Satellite Program (NYSP) 🚀 Launch Attendance 🌴 Generous Time Off Policy 🎓 Education Assistance Program 🥰 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) 📈 Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) 👣 Family Leave 💪 Fitness Reimbursement 🧡 Employee Referral Program 🍉 Healthy snacks & beverages in every office About Spire We improve life on Earth with data from space. Spire Global is a space-to-cloud analytics company that owns and operates the largest multi-purpose constellation of satellites. Its proprietary data and algorithms provide the most advanced maritime, aviation, and weather tracking in the world. In addition to its constellation, Spire's data infrastructure includes a global ground station network and 24/7 operations that provide real-time global coverage of every point on Earth. Spire is Global and our success draws upon the diverse viewpoints, skills and experiences of our employees. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status. To help maintain a safe and secure workplace for Spire employees, all candidates who receive a conditional offer will be required to complete a background check . This may include criminal history and employment verification. Please take a moment to review Spire's Global Data Privacy Notice for Employees, Contractors, Candidates and Visitors , as well as Spire's Privacy Policy. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 class="job-details__description-header text-color-secondary font-family-secondary" data-bind="i18n: 'job-details.employer-description-title'">About Us</h2> <div class="job-details__description-content basic-formatter" data-bind="html: pageData().job.corporateDescription"> <div>Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. title: Computational Chemist (gn) @ Chemistry AI Venture, London
description: This an Atlantic portfolio venture. About the Venture This early-stage venture is building a discovery engine for chemistry, comprising a platform for running end-to-end simulations of chemical reaction systems, and a world model + agent stack that uses the simulation platform to discover new chemistry. Their goal is to build backend scientific data infrastructure to meet the demands of AI systems that can truly accelerate and automate the discovery layer of chemistry. Both founders hold PhDs in Chemistry from the University of Oxford, and the venture has already secured pre-seed funding. They are now building out their founding team. The Role As a Computational Chemist, you will play a central role in shaping the scientific foundations of the venture's technology, helping develop the computational methods and workflows that underpin its end-to-end chemical reaction simulation platform. You’ll work closely with researchers and engineers to integrate state-of-the-art computational chemistry methods with machine learning approaches, driving progress towards the venture's strategic and scientific objectives. You’ll take ownership of developing, validating and optimising the computational chemistry components of the platform, with a particular focus on reaction mechanisms, reaction kinetics, molecular dynamics and the modelling of complex chemical environments. You will design, implement and refine scalable scientific workflows for generating, processing and analysing chemical reaction data, improving the accuracy, reliability and computational efficiency of simulations. Beyond your core scientific responsibilities, the team is looking for someone who can contribute to strategic research decisions, bring strong independent scientific judgement, and help shape the interdisciplinary research culture of the company at an early stage. What You'll Work On Foundation models for chemical reactivity: The team is building and training foundation models for chemical reactivity with a variety of data modalities. You'll help curate this foundational data corpus by developing cheminformatics and computational chemistry workflows for generating data from combinatorial enumeration, as well as robust data filtering, clustering and validation routines. Computational methods: The team is working on efficient computational methods from which foundational data is generated and the platform is validated. You'll be responsible for developing protocols for estimating solvation and entropy factors in chemical reaction steps. This involves keeping up to date with published literature for ideas and inspiration. Generative models: The venture is expanding its foundational data corpus beyond combinatorial workflows. You'll help design, validate and benchmark the generative model architectures that accomplish this. Chemical reaction simulation: The team is building out an end-to-end chemical reaction simulation platform. You'll be involved in designing the architecture and assembling the platform, as well as developing benchmarks and validation protocols against computational and experimental methods. World models and agents: The venture will be developing an agent + world model stack that operates on the simulation platform. You'll be responsible for formulating the action space in which the world model is trained and the agent explores new chemical reaction space. What They're Looking For The team is looking for someone who enjoys being given a blank canvas and the chance to create something spectacular with it. In particular, someone who brings: A PhD in Computational Chemistry, Machine Learning, or a related field. Intellectual curiosity: Someone who enjoys venturing outside their comfort zone, exploring new ideas and applying their knowledge and experience to unfamiliar domains. An entrepreneurial mindset: Someone who thrives in an early-stage environment, enjoys building things from scratch and is excited to grow beyond the traditional boundaries of their role. Independent thinking and scientific judgement: Someone who can take ownership of complex challenges, contribute new ideas and help shape the scientific direction of the venture. A collaborative approach: Someone who can build strong relationships across the team and actively contribute to shaping and nurturing the company culture as it grows. An instinct for building great working environments: Someone who understands the importance of the right tools, systems and ways of working to help themselves and the wider team do their best work. If you’re passionate about autonomy and the impact you could make at Wayve, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. Instead of relying on hand-coded rules or pre-mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once-in-a-generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human-driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware-agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2+ through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real-world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
description: At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge? As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly. This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job. Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices. What You'll Work On You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include: Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist. What Success Looks Like Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable. Who We're Looking For We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious. Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning No active backlogs Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++ Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before. Our Culture More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning. At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it. Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Consumer Duty Specialist
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role In this role, you will play a central part in assessing, questioning, and enhancing how customers experience Pleo. Drawing on deep regulatory knowledge, you will lead Consumer Duty initiatives, actively spot potential customer harm, examine what drives customer journeys, and ensure targeted remediation creates lasting, positive impact. You'll need sharp analytical skills and the confidence to influence stakeholders, translating data and MI into decisive action. You will construct and manage dashboards and reporting mechanisms that illuminate emerging patterns, vulnerable customer risks, and key concerns, offering executive leadership clear visibility into operational gaps and necessary solutions. Your contribution goes well beyond producing MI. You will conduct QA across complex complaint handling and sensitive customer interactions, manage Ombudsman cases, and speak up when evidence shows outcomes aren't meeting expectations. Collaborating across teams, you'll turn data-driven insights into practical improvements, drive projects to completion, and evaluate whether changes deliver real results for our users. We're seeking someone who views Consumer Duty as a powerful driver of business improvement rather than a routine compliance exercise. You'll bring together technical understanding, rigorous analysis, and constructive challenge to investigate root causes, align key partners, deliver change, and prove that customer experiences are continuously getting better. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You'll work closely with teams across Customer Support, Complaints, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, Data, Technology, and other business functions. The role will have broad exposure across the organisation, particularly when customer outcome risks or Consumer Duty-related remediation require cross-functional action. You'll also work closely with senior stakeholders through Consumer Duty governance and reporting, helping translate detailed analysis into clear insights, risks, recommendations, and actions. What you’ll be doing As a Consumer Duty Specialist, you will: Turn data into customer outcome insight : Build and own MI, dashboards, KPIs, and reporting that give the business a clear view of customer outcomes, trends, risks, and emerging areas of concern. Own Consumer Duty reporting : Produce monthly and quarterly Consumer Duty reporting, turning complex data into a clear story for senior leadership and Board-level audiences. You'll go beyond showing what happened to explain why it matters and what we should do about it . Identify customer harm : Use complaints, QA findings, customer feedback, vulnerable customer data, Ombudsman cases, and MI to identify potential customer harm, emerging risks, and systemic issues. Challenge the business : Where the evidence suggests customers aren't receiving good outcomes, you'll be expected to ask difficult questions, challenge assumptions, and ensure the issue is properly understood and addressed. Drive remediation and change : Work with stakeholders across the business to agree remediation plans, establish clear owners and timelines, and help drive Consumer Duty-related projects and improvements through to completion. Provide complaints QA : Conduct weekly quality reviews of complaints handled by the Complaints Manager, using findings to identify quality issues, customer risks, and wider trends. Manage Ombudsman activity : Act as the primary operational contact with the UK Ombudsman, managing referred complaints, responses, remedies, compensation, invoices, and related communications. Leverage AI and smart automation : Spot opportunities to apply automated tools and AI to scale and streamline Consumer Duty analytics, monitoring, and workflows. You will feel empowered to test emerging tech and eliminate repetitive manual work, maintaining proper critical evaluation and human governance whenever compliance risks or customer impacts are involved. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: Strong Consumer Duty knowledge : You understand the principles of Consumer Duty and how they translate into practical customer outcomes, particularly across complaints, customer support, vulnerable customers, and customer journeys. Strong data and MI experience : You know how to take complex data, build meaningful dashboards and reporting, and identify the insights that actually matter. You're comfortable working with data rather than simply consuming reports created by others. A customer outcome mindset : You're naturally curious about how customers are experiencing the business and are able to connect data, customer feedback, complaints, and operational activity to real customer outcomes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills : You can spot trends, anomalies, and patterns, investigate root causes, and determine whether an issue is isolated or potentially systemic. The confidence to challenge : You're comfortable questioning decisions, processes, and assumptions when the evidence suggests customers may be experiencing poor outcomes. You can challenge constructively and build relationships at the same time. A bias towards action : You don't believe reporting is the end of the process. You want to understand what needs to change, bring people together, and help make it happen. Project and remediation experience : You're comfortable managing actions, timelines, dependencies, stakeholders, and risks across cross-functional projects, particularly where there is a regulatory, customer, or operational outcome to deliver. An AI and automation mindset : You're naturally curious about how AI and automation can make processes more efficient, improve analysis, and free up time for higher-value work. You look for sensible opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and use AI to augment your thinking, while maintaining appropriate human oversight, critical judgement, and accountability — particularly where customer outcomes or regulatory decisions are involved. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You love using data to uncover things that others might not see. You want your analysis to drive real change, rather than sit in a report or dashboard. You enjoy asking "why?" and getting to the root cause of customer problems. You're comfortable challenging the business when the evidence tells you something isn't working. This role is not a good fit for you if: You prefer to produce reporting without being involved in what happens afterwards. You're uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or having difficult conversations when customer outcomes aren't where they should be. You prefer working within a narrow functional remit rather than across multiple teams. How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll: Build a deep understanding of our customer outcome data, existing Consumer Duty MI, complaints, vulnerable customer journeys, and current areas of risk. Take ownership of key Consumer Duty dashboards and reporting, developing a clear view of the metrics and insights that matter most. Establish strong relationships with stakeholders across Customer Support, Complaints, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, Data, and Technology. Lead the analysis behind Consumer Duty reporting and help shape how customer outcomes are presented to senior stakeholders and the Board. Over time, you'll have the opportunity to shape how Pleo measures, understands, and improves customer outcomes, helping move Consumer Duty from a regulatory obligation into a genuine driver of better customer experiences and better business decisions. Show me the benefits! Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. Meet the Hiring Manager: 1hr going through role in more depth. Pleo Challenge: A case study were you talk us through how you'd solve a work appropriate challenge. Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! Last time we advertised this role, we received a really high volume of applications but could only select so many. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include: CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background! Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t

title: Senior Engagement Manager
description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. About the Role The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the centre of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced Engagement Manager to own Legora's global relationship with one of the Big 4, one of our most significant partnerships, and to fundamentally change the way that firm works with Legora. This is a role for someone who has led change inside large, complex organisations and knows that real transformation is designed and managed. You will own the adoption and long-term success of this client globally: building the relationships, defining the outcomes and serving as the trusted adviser and orchestrator who turns Legora into an embedded part of how their teams operate. Global means global. You will set the strategy for how the firm adopts Legora worldwide, and Engagement Managers in other regions will run their local programmes against the direction and decisions you set. Day to day, you will be the point of contact for the firm's UK and Ireland practice from our London office, and you will travel regularly to other member firms in the network to build those relationships and land the programme on the ground. Expect to be travelling around 25% of the time. At the heart of the role is designing the client's adoption playbook and delivering a multi-year change-management programme that transforms how they work. You will build the roadmap, sequence initiatives from initial rollout through firm-wide scaled adoption, define measurable outcomes and ROI and evolve the programme as new AI capabilities and use cases emerge. You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption programme at Legora, helping the client realise measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work. What You'll Do You'll own the global relationship end to end, leading the post-sale experience across every member firm we work with. Specifically, you will: ● Set the global adoption strategy for the account and lead its execution across regions. Engagement Managers in other markets will deliver their local programmes against the strategy and decisions you set, and you will be accountable for coherence and outcomes globally. ● Act as the primary point of contact for the firm's UK and Ireland practice, while travelling frequently to other member firms to build senior relationships and support local delivery in person. ● Design the client's adoption playbook: the tailored change-management approach, stakeholder map and target outcomes for how the firm adopts Legora and transforms the way it works. ● Execute against that playbook, sequencing initiatives from initial rollout to enterprise-wide scaled adoption and adapting as the client's needs and Legora's capabilities evolve. ● Act as a strategic adviser who deeply understands the client's goals and legal and professional services workflows, surfaces high-impact opportunities and guides teams towards maximum value from Legora. ● Drive sustained value through a structured operating cadence: success plans, enablement, stakeholder check-ins, training and value reviews. ● Orchestrate engagement from cross-functional teams to accelerate client success (GTM, Product, Legal Engineering, Engineering, Marketing, Support), maintaining end-to-end account context and coordination globally. ● Partner with GTM on key commercial moments to ensure seamless transitions, continuity and exceptional customer experience, and to identify and realise expansion opportunities across the account. ● Translate customer feedback into action by collaborating closely with Product, Engineering and Marketing to inform roadmap, positioning and enablement. What You Bring You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation has to be designed and led. You're proactive, strategic and comfortable steering demanding, senior stakeholders through significant change. You take pride in being the reason customers adopt, grow and succeed. We're looking for: ● 5+ years experience in management consulting, legal, LegalTech or customer success in an AI-native B2B vertical. ● Extensive experience working with or inside a Big 4 firm is highly desirable, we want someone who already understands how these firms are structured, how decisions get made and how change actually lands across member firms. ● A consulting or transformation background, with a demonstrated track record of designing and delivering change-management programmes inside large, complex organisations. ● Experience building tailored transformation roadmaps and adoption plans and steering them to measurable outcomes. ● A track record of driving adoption, retention and satisfaction with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders. ● Experience leading through influence rather than direct authority. You will set the direction that colleagues in other regions deliver against, so you need to be able to bring people with you. ● Experience working with legal, compliance or other regulated and complex industries or the ability to learn a complex domain exceptionally fast. ● Strong programme and project management skills; you keep multi-workstream initiatives moving and your clients confident. ● Excellent communication skills — written, verbal and interpersonal. You can lead boardroom conversations with legal and professional services leaders and roll up your sleeves with hands-on teams. ● High EQ: you know when to listen, when to advise and when to act. ● A love of fast-paced, early-stage environments where you help build the playbook, not just follow it. ● Fluency with metrics and driven by data, customer health and outcomes over process. ● Willingness to travel internationally around 25% of the time. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. description: UK | Full-Time The Mission: Source.dev Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. The Core Product: SourceFS SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes. 10x Faster Builds: Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed. 10x Lower Costs: Enabling a standard 16-vCPU machine to outperform even a 128-vCPU machine. True Engineering Productivity: Replaying hundreds of thousands of build steps instantly when inputs match. It’s about more than just tasks; it’s the dedication to see things through, staying curious to solve problems, thinking from first principles and ensuring we fix our customer’s problems in the best possible way.” The Role: Pushing the Speed Limits of Rust, Linux & I/O We are looking for a Performance / Systems Engineer to join us at Source.dev . In this role, your primary metric of success is speed. You will dissect execution paths, eliminate kernel-space context-switching costs, optimize memory layouts, and ensure SourceFS runs as close to the hardware limits as physically possible. What You’ll Work On System Bottleneck Hunting: Profile, trace, and eliminate latency across CPU, memory, and disk I/O bottlenecks in Rust systems code using tools like perf, eBPF, valgrind, and custom microbenchmarks. Kernel & File System Tuning: Deep dive into Linux kernel interactions, optimizing FUSE drivers, VFS caches, asynchronous I/O (io_uring), memory-mapped execution, and thread scheduling. Memory & Cache Efficiency: Optimize data structures for cache locality, minimize allocation overhead, and eliminate unnecessary memory copies across boundary transitions. Benchmarking Infrastructure: Design robust, reproducible benchmarking suites to measure micro- and macro-performance regression in high-concurrency environments. Scaling Build Primitives: Squeeze peak performance out of massive build graphs (Android, Yocto, and more) running on high-core hardware configurations. Ideal Candidate Profile: The Performance Systems Mindset: You have a deep understanding of computer architecture (CPU caches, memory barriers, SIMD, system calls) and proven experience writing hyper-optimized code in Rust or C/C++.(or other). No prior experience with Rust required, just a willingness to learn is all we are looking for. Scale-Obsessed: You have experience with (or a burning desire to fix) large-scale build systems and developer tooling. Impact-Driven: You embody the "Own It" mentality - you see a friction point in the developer journey and you don’t stop until it’s gone. Curious & Collaborative: You enjoy translating real-world customer problems into robust, production-grade solutions. Low Ego, High Impact: Beyond being a brilliant coder, you are a thoughtful and empathetic teammate - someone who leads with kindness Feedback Culture Champion: You embrace feedback and provide it thoughtfully; you see open, honest communication as the foundation of great teamwork. title: Finance Manager
description: We’re building the next generation of employee benefits infrastructure. At Happl, we help global teams design, manage, and scale benefits that actually work for their people by using AI, across flex allowances, benefits, insurance, recognition, and wellbeing, all in one intelligent platform. Happl is backed by leading investors such as YCombinator, 6Degrees Capital, Haatch, Portage , and more, known for backing leading companies such as Deel, Rippling, Airbnb, Coinbase, Dropbox , and most recently was awarded a place in the UK’s top 100 startups for 2026 . About the role As Financial Controller at Happl, you’ll own the financial engine of the business — everything from the cash in the bank to the numbers our board and investors use to make decisions runs through you. You’ll run the monthly close, the full revenue cycle, the compliance calendar across two jurisdictions, and our treasury position, and you’ll decide how all of it gets built, systemised, and automated. This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with a direct line to leadership. You won’t be managing a process someone else designed — you’ll be deciding what good looks like across revenue, cash, compliance, and reporting, then making it happen. You’ll work closely with the CEO, the board, our investors, and our outsourced bookkeeping, audit, and tax partners, holding all of it to a standard that matches the product we’ve built. We’re FCA-regulated and YCombinator-backed, having raised $11m to date, and we give global employers a single place to design, deliver, and manage benefits across 160+ countries and 70+ languages — which means the finance function behind the product has to be just as sharp as the product itself. We’re entering our next phase of growth, with an ambitious revenue trajectory and an expanding international footprint, and this role sits at the centre of it. What you’ll be doing Owning the monthly close on a fixed timetable — management accounts, balance sheet integrity, accruals, prepayments, and the revenue and cost reconciliations that sit behind them Writing the commentary that explains what’s actually happened in the business, not just what the numbers say Producing the monthly investor reporting pack and the financial sections of board materials — ARR and revenue analysis, cash and runway, burn efficiency, unit economics, cohort and retention metrics, and budget versus actual Owning the full revenue cycle — invoicing, collections, aged debt, and revenue recognition across a multi-currency, multi-contract subscription base Leading the rollout of automated billing and revenue recognition tooling, moving us from manual tracking to a system that scales without adding headcount Managing our two legal entities — a US TopCo and a UK operating company — including statutory accounts, audit preparation, intercompany accounting, transfer pricing mechanics, and FX exposure between them Owning the compliance calendar end to end across both jurisdictions — UK VAT returns, corporation tax, US federal and state filings, sales tax where applicable, and payroll taxes Supporting our FCA regulatory reporting obligations and the financial controls that sit behind them Running monthly payroll across jurisdictions , pension and benefits administration, employee expenses, and the finance side of onboarding and offboarding Owning the cash position and treasury strategy — cash flow forecasting, working capital, FX management, and structuring how we hold company funds to earn a sensible return without taking risk we shouldn’t Managing our outsourced bookkeeping , accounting, and tax partners — holding them to deadlines and quality, and pulling work in-house where doing so makes us faster Owning the finance tech stack and having a strong opinion on it , actively replacing manual work with automation and AI-assisted workflows across reconciliations, invoice processing, variance analysis, and reporting drafts Leveraging AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to speed up your own work and build the systems that let finance scale without adding headcount Acting as the financial conscience of the business , with a direct line to the founders and a real say in how we grow What we’re looking for Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA), or qualified by experience with a track record that stands up to scrutiny Genuine ownership of a monthly close cycle and management reporting pack, start to finish Strong technical grounding in revenue recognition, accruals accounting, and balance sheet control Comfortable with tax and compliance across VAT, corporation tax, and payroll, ideally spanning both the UK and US AI-native in your approach — you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can talk specifically about what you’ve automated and what it saved you Exceptional attention to detail, alongside the judgement to know when precision matters and when speed does A clear communicator — you can explain a number to a non-finance audience without patronising them or losing them Ideally, SaaS or subscription business experience, particularly ARR reporting and deferred revenue, and familiarity with modern billing infrastructure like Xero or Stripe Comfort with SQL, Python, or low-code automation tools is a bonus, not a requirement, but it will make your life here significantly easier What to expect Being Financial Controller at Happl is not a maintenance role. You’ll be building the finance function as you run it — choosing the systems, designing the controls, and deciding how billing, revenue recognition, and reporting should work as we scale into new markets and currencies. That’s not a caveat; it’s the role. Some weeks will be genuinely rewarding — a reporting pack you built gives the board real clarity, a manual process you automated saves the team hours every month, a treasury decision you made puts real value on the table. Some will be hard — closing the books on a fixed timetable, holding partners and advisors to a deadline, and making judgement calls across two jurisdictions with incomplete information. What you get in return is real scope. You’ll own the whole picture — revenue, cash, compliance, treasury, and reporting — across two jurisdictions and 160+ countries of operations, with a direct line to the founders and reporting that goes straight to the board and our investors. This is the foundation of a finance function that will grow with the business, and the right person grows with it. Why join Happl Be part of building something that genuinely matters — the future of how companies support their people Competitive salary that reflects the impact you’ll have Real equity — a meaningful stake in what we’re building together Hybrid working from day one, with the trust and flexibility to do your best work Your own Happl account — use the platform you’re helping to build and shape Private Health Insurance, because we genuinely care about how you’re doing Dental insurance, including family cover A personal Wellbeing budget to spend however wellbeing works for you — no questions asked A dedicated L&D budget to grow in the direction that excites you Pension — we’re invested in your future, not just the short term About the Interview Stage 1: 20-min Intro call with Ben Shorrock (Head of Operations) Stage 2: Short task Stage 3: 30-min deep dive and task review with Ben T (CEO) & Ben S (Ops) Additional Details Location: London, Holborn Team: Finance Reports to: CEO Working arrangement: Hybrid (4+ Days in Office) #BS-L1 Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>About Us:</strong>  </p> <p>We love going to work and think you should too. Our team is dedicated to trust, customer obsession, agility, and striving to be better everyday. These values serve as the foundation of our culture, guiding our actions and driving us towards excellence. We foster a culture of performance and recognition, allowing us to transform growth as we enable our employees to do the best work of their careers.</p> <p><strong>This position is located in London, England. </strong>Our office is situated in a core location near Waterloo and Blackfriars on the Southbank. Across the globe, our Centers of Energy serve as hubs where we accelerate productivity and collaboration, inspire creativity, and cultivate a culture of connection and celebration. Our teams coordinate their time in Centers of Energy to reflect how they work best.</p> <p>To learn more about life at LogicMonitor, check out our <a href="https://www.logicmonitor.com/careers">Careers Page</a>.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <p>LogicMonitor® is the AI-first hybrid observability platform powering the next generation of digital infrastructure. LogicMonitor delivers complete visibility and actionable intelligence across on-premises, cloud, and edge environments. By anticipating issues before they strike, optimizing resources in real time, and enabling faster, smarter decisions, LogicMonitor helps IT and business leaders protect margins, accelerate innovation, and deliver exceptional digital experiences without compromise.</p> <p>Our customers love LogicMonitor's ability to bring cloud and traditional IT together into one view, as seen in minimal churn rates, expansion business, and exciting new customer references. In fact, LogicMonitor has received the highest Net Promoter Score of any IT Infrastructure Management provider. LogicMonitor also boasts high employee satisfaction. We have been certified as a Great Place To Work®, and named one of BuiltIn's Best Places to Work for the seventh year in a row!</p> <p>We’re looking for a Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer who enjoys solving real customer problems through hands-on engineering and AI-driven solutions. In this role, you will work closely with senior engineers, product teams, and customers to design, build, and deploy tailored solutions that extend LogicMonitor Edwin AI. As a Forward deploy Engineer, you will be operating at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development, with ownership of discovery, scoping, system design, build, rollout, and measurable adoption.</p> <div data-hasbody="true" data-macro-name="panel"> <div data-hasbody="true" data-macro-name="panel"> <p>This is a customer facing engineering role at the intersection of software engineering, observability, and AI deployment. You will ship code, implement integrations, support production rollouts, and codify repeatable patterns that improve both customer outcomes and the core platform.</p> </div> <p><strong>Here's a closer look at this key role:<br></strong></p> <ul> <li> <h3><strong>Build & Support AI-Powered Solutions</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner directly with strategic customers to build production applications, ship technical artifacts used in production workflows, codify repeatable deployment patterns, and represent the company in highly ambiguous enterprise environments.</li> <li>Partner with Engineers and customers to understand use cases, workflows, and technical requirements.</li> <li>Build and maintain backend services, integrations, automations, and lightweight full stack experiences using Python and JavaScript or TypeScript. </li> <li>Implement REST API, webhook, and SDK based integrations that normalize, enrich, and route operational data into LogicMonitor Edwin AI. </li> <li>Instrument and troubleshoot telemetry across logs, metrics, traces, and related workflow data, including OpenTelemetry based pipelines where appropriate. </li> <li>Configure and deploy solutions in SaaS, hybrid cloud, and customer managed environments, with working familiarity across containers, Kubernetes, CI or CD, and infrastructure automation. </li> <li>Define or refine dashboards, alerting, service boundaries, and reliability workflows so customer teams can operate what is deployed. </li> <li>Partner during go live, hypercare, and troubleshooting periods to drive adoption, reduce friction, and make the solution durable in production. </li> <li>Convert repeated field learnings into templates, playbooks, reusable components, and product feedback for core engineering and product teams.</li> </ul> <span style="font-size: 8pt; color: rgb(126, 140, 141);"><br></span> <h3><strong>Technical Execution</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Write clean, maintainable code across backend and frontend systems, deployed solutions.</li> <li>Follow engineering best practices for reliability, security, and performance.</li> <li>Contribute to internal documentation and knowledge sharing.</li> <li>Reusable artifacts created, such as templates, integration patterns, playbooks, or productized improvements. </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Prototype & Iterate</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Help develop MVPs and proof-of-concept solutions to validate customer use cases.</li> <li>Incorporate feedback from customers and internal stakeholders to refine functionality.</li> <li>Support the transition of validated solutions into scalable product capabilities in collaboration with product and core engineering teams.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Customer & Partner Collaboration</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Participate in technical discussions with customers and partners alongside senior engineers.</li> <li>Provide implementation support and troubleshooting during deployments.</li> <li>Share insights and feedback from customer engagements with internal teams to improve product quality and usability.</li> <li>Production deployments launched and adopted by named customer teams. </li> <li>Time to first value, such as first workflow live, first integration live, or first meaningful AI investigation or automation in production. </li> <li>Measurable workflow impact, such as reduced manual triage, faster incident handling, lower alert noise, or improved operational efficiency. </li> <li>Strong implementation quality, documentation quality, and stakeholder satisfaction.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <div><strong>What You'll Need:</strong> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.</li> <li>4-7 years of experience in backend or data systems engineering.</li> <li>Experience building streaming data pipelines (Kafka / Spark or any similar technology).</li> <li>Strong programming background in Java and Python, including microservice design.</li> <li>Experience with ETL, data modeling, and distributed storage systems.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to ship clean, production quality code in Java or Python plus JavaScript or TypeScript, whether gained in software engineering, platform engineering, solutions engineering, SRE, or technical consulting. </li> <li>Demonstrated ability to integrate external systems using APIs, SDKs, authentication controls, payload mapping, and schema validation. </li> <li>Working knowledge of observability fundamentals, including logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerting, root cause investigation, and incident workflows. </li> <li>Familiarity with OpenTelemetry concepts and telemetry pipelines, including how data is instrumented, collected, and routed across systems. </li> <li>Working knowledge of modern cloud and deployment tooling such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, containers, Kubernetes, CI or CD, and infrastructure automation tools. </li> <li>Practical exposure to AI application patterns such as LLM APIs, agents or workflows, evaluation basics, and the observability of AI systems in production. </li> <li>Strong debugging judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to make progress in ambiguous customer environments. </li> <li>Awareness of data governance, validation, and lineage best practices.</li> <li>Strong communication and collaboration across AI, Data, and Platform teams.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, product teams, and customer stakeholders. </li> <li>Nice to have: ServiceNow or Jira title: Sr. AI Growth Strategist
description: <h3><strong>About Us</strong></h3> <p>We love going to work and think you should too. Our team is dedicated to trust, customer obsession, agility, and striving to be better everyday. These values serve as the foundation of our culture, guiding our actions and driving us towards excellence. We foster a culture of performance and recognition, allowing us to transform growth as we enable our employees to do the best work of their careers.</p> <p>LogicMonitor® is the AI-first hybrid observability platform powering the next generation of digital infrastructure. LogicMonitor delivers complete visibility and actionable intelligence across on-premises, cloud, and edge environments. By anticipating issues before they strike, optimizing resources in real time, and enabling faster, smarter decisions, LogicMonitor helps IT and business leaders protect margins, accelerate innovation, and deliver exceptional digital experiences without compromise.</p> <p>Our customers love LogicMonitor's ability to bring cloud and traditional IT together into one view, as seen in minimal churn rates, expansion business, and exciting new customer references. In fact, LogicMonitor has received the highest Net Promoter Score of any IT Infrastructure Management provider. LogicMonitor also boasts high employee satisfaction. We have been certified as a Great Place To Work®, and named one of BuiltIn's Best Places to Work for the seventh year in a row! </p> <p>To learn more about life at LogicMonitor, check out our <a href="https://www.logicmonitor.com/careers">Careers Page</a>.</p> <h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3> <p>AI Growth Strategists own the ongoing technical and business success of a portfolio of strategic Edwin AI customers. This is not a traditional Customer Success role and it is not a pure strategy or consulting role. The strategist sits between the customer’s technical environment, operational workflows and business priorities.</p> <p>Edwin AI operates across complex enterprise environments. Customer outcomes depend on observability and monitoring data, integrations, APIs, ITSM workflows, automation, cloud and infrastructure architecture, data quality and the way each customer operates. The strategist must be able to understand that environment, diagnose what is blocking adoption, bring the right technical resources together and maintain credibility with technical stakeholders.</p> <p>At the same time, the strategist must connect technical use cases and operational improvements to measurable business outcomes, executive priorities, retention and growth. You will work with technical practitioners, operational leaders and C-level stakeholders, moving comfortably between all three<strong>.</strong></p> <div data-hasbody="true" data-macro-name="panel"> <h3><strong>What You’ll Own</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the success of a portfolio of strategic and complex Edwin AI customers from post-implementation adoption through value realisation, maturity, advocacy and growth.</li> <li>Build a deep understanding of each customer’s architecture, observability environment, integrations, ITSM processes, operational workflows and AI use cases.</li> <li>Lead technical and operational discovery to understand customer requirements, diagnose adoption blockers and determine whether issues relate to configuration, integration, data, workflow, product capability or customer environment.</li> <li>Act as a credible technical partner to SRE, DevOps, platform, infrastructure, operations and engineering stakeholders while coordinating Support, Product and Engineering when deeper expertise is required.</li> <li>Translate technical capabilities, usage and operational outcomes into business value that is meaningful to CIOs, CTOs and other executive stakeholders.</li> <li>Develop and execute customer success and growth plans with clear use cases, success measures, adoption milestones, risks and value metrics.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to expand Edwin across additional teams, workflows and use cases based on demonstrated customer outcomes and technical fit.</li> <li>Represent the Voice of the Customer: investigate the underlying problem behind feature requests, quantify impact, identify patterns across customers and build evidence-based cases for Product and Engineering.</li> <li>Proactively manage customer risk and technical escalations, maintaining clear customer communication while driving internal ownership and resolution.</li> <li>Run executive and operational customer cadences that demonstrate adoption, measurable value, risks, priorities and next steps.</li> <li>Capture repeatable use cases, technical patterns, customer outcomes and lessons learned to improve team playbooks and product strategy.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Technical Expectations</strong></h3> <p>This role does not require you to be a software engineer, but it does require genuine technical depth. You should be able to enter an unfamiliar customer environment, ask the right questions, understand how systems connect, interpret technical evidence and narrow down where a problem is likely to sit.</p> <p>You should be comfortable discussing observability and monitoring concepts, APIs and integrations, ITSM workflows, cloud and infrastructure environments, automation, data flows and AI-driven operational use cases. You should know when you can progress the investigation yourself and when to bring in Support, Engineering or Product.</p> <p>You will be expected to learn Edwin AI deeply and maintain enough technical credibility that customers see you as part of the solution rather than simply a relationship manager.</p> <h3><strong>AI Mindset</strong></h3> <p>AI curiosity is essential. We want people who actively experiment with AI in their own work, not simply people who advise customers about it.</p> <p>You should be able to demonstrate how you use AI, agents, automation or emerging tools to improve your productivity, analyse information, create workflows or solve problems. You will be encouraged to test new approaches safely, learn quickly and turn successful experiments into repeatable ways of working for the wider team and our customers.</p> <h3><strong>Customer & Executive Leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build trusted relationships across technical practitioners, operational leaders and executive sponsors.</li> <li>Challenge customers constructively when the requested feature or approach may not be the best way to achieve the desired outcome.</li> <li>Lead conversations about business impact, ROI, operational efficiency, automation, risk reduction and AI maturity.</li> <li>Manage multiple demanding enterprise customers and competing priorities with clear judgement, ownership and communication.</li> <li>Create executive-level narratives that connect technical progress and adoption to the customer’s wider business objectives.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Customers adopt Edwin faster and expand its use across meaningful operational workflows.</li> <li>Technical and operational blockers are identified early, accurately understood and driven to resolution.</li> <li>Customers can clearly articulate the measurable business and operational value they receive from Edwin.</li> <li>Executive sponsors remain engaged and confident in the value and direction of their Edwin investment.</li> <li>Customer risk is reduced and retention improves through proactive technical and strategic engagement.</li> <li>Expansion opportunities emerge naturally from proven use cases, adoption and demonstrated value.</li> <li>Customer feedback is evidence-based and meaningfully influences Product and Engineering priorities.</li> <li>The AI Growth team develops stronger technical playbooks, reusable use cases and AI-enabled ways of working.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h3> <ul> <li>7+ years in Technical Account Management, Solutions Architecture/Consulting, Professional Services, technical Customer Success, cloud/observability, AI/ML or another technical customer-facing enterprise role.</li> <li>Proven ownership of a portfolio of complex enterprise customers or equivalent long-term responsibility for customer technical outcomes, adoption and value.</li> <li>Strong technical aptitude across enterprise SaaS, integrations/APIs, cloud or infrastructure environments, operational workflows and troubleshooting.</li> <li>Experience with observability, monitoring, AIOps, IT operations, ITSM, SRE/DevOps or adjacent technologies is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Demonstrated AI curiosity and practical use of GenAI, agents, automation or AI-enabled workflows in your own work.</li> <li>Ability to conduct technical discovery and translate complex use cases into measurable operational and business outcomes.</li> <li>Experience engaging C-level stakeholders and presenting value, risk, progress and recommendations at executive level.</li> <li>Commercial awareness and the ability to identify growth opportunities based on customer outcomes rather than traditional product selling.</li> <li>Strong customer advocacy skills, including turning individual requests into structured, evidence-based product feedback.</li> <li>Comfort operating in ambiguity, building new processes and improving playbooks as the product and function evolve.</li> <li>Native/fluent Dutch language skills (if applying for the role based The Netherlands)</li> </ul> <br><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Click <a title: Software Engineer
description: <p><strong>Role:                                 Software Engineer</strong><strong><br></strong><strong>Department:                     Engineering</strong><strong><br></strong><strong>Location:                          UK - London </strong><br><strong>Reports into:                    Lead Software Engineer</strong><br><br></p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>disguise is looking for a mid-level software engineer who considers themselves a generalist programmer. You will work in a small, highly focused team that is light on process and hands-on by default, writing software for demanding end users in situations where failure is visible to an audience of thousands.</p> <p>Our products design, sequence and control live productions across film and TV, broadcast, and live events. The code you write runs in front of an audience, often with no second take.</p> <p><strong>What you will do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own delivery of projects: customer projects, large features and internal tooling</li> <li>Build and help specify new features, working with Product to shape them</li> <li>Improve, support and maintain existing areas of the product</li> <li>Write testable, maintainable code, and the unit tests that prove it</li> <li>Debug methodically, using tools and logging to establish root cause rather than symptom</li> <li>Review the work of others constructively, explaining the reasoning behind a correction</li> <li>Work closely with Support so they understand issues in the codebase</li> <li>Share knowledge of your areas with the wider team</li> </ul> <p><strong>Essential experience we are looking for: </strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years experience writing C++ in a professional environment</li> <li>Experience releasing at least one commercial software product</li> <li>Experience working in a team to create code, review code and fix bugs</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirables:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Background in high performance, real-time systems</li> <li>Experience of Visual Studio, Python, Windows, DirectX</li> <li>Graphics development, Unreal Engine 5, or games industry experience</li> <li>Media server experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills, behaviour and values we are looking for: </strong></p> <ul> <li>You will have clear communication, both verbal and written</li> </ul> <ul> <li>You will have excellent attention to detail, when writing and reviewing code</li> <li>You will enjoy problem solving complex issues with a curious and inquisitive mind</li> <li>You will be technically competent and interested in building out a product (ie, what the product should do, what else can make the product great)</li> <li>You will be collaborative, working with the team to build a product and knowledge share</li> <li>You will be pragmatic in the way you approach writing code</li> <li>You will be passionate to expand your knowledge </li> <li>You will have the resilience to keep experimenting</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Disguise</strong></p> <p>Disguise is the industry-leading platform sitting at the heart of a new era of visual experiences. One powerful integrated system of software, hardware and services to help create the next dimension of real-time spectacle.<br>We partner with the biggest entertainment brands and companies in the world to deliver the A-list of live music events, live TV broadcasts, immersive experiences, installations, theatre, film and TV production, corporate communications and brand product launches. Working with Disney, Snapchat, Netflix, ESPN, the Burj Khalifa, and Adele, Disguise is the number one partner delivering the next dimension of entertainment. </p> <p>Watch our <a href="https://vimeo.com/1152697197?fl=pl&fe=sh">showreel</a></p> <p><strong><em>Don’t Disguise your differences.</em></strong></p> <p>Innovation comes from everyone. We strive to create a workplace that reflects our diverse audience. We celebrate our people for their full authentic selves, and embrace uniqueness. Inclusion and Equity matter at Disguise. We create together and we create everywhere. </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Our values</strong></p> <ul> <li><em>Honest. We are real with ourselves and our clients and share our ideas with openness and transparency. </em></li> <li><em>Evolutionary. We innovate using our user’s ever-changing needs so our technology remains ahead-of-the-game.</em></li> <li><em>Fearless. title: Product Lead - AI Stockbroking App
description: About Doit We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. The Role We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App. This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads. What You'll Own Lead product direction for major AI Stockbroking app areas. Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads. Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution. Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services. Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions. Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement. Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement. What We're Looking For Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features. Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes. Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing. Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage. Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure. Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys. Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage. The Kind of Builder We Want Can set direction and still go deep into details. Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality. Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no. Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy. Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams. This Role Is Not For Product leaders who only manage people and meetings. People who cannot go deep into product details. Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment. Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact. People who need large teams before they can create progress. Location This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

This role will bring together activities currently undertaken across different parts of the organisation, establish clear ownership and controls, and build a scalable treasury capability for the Group.</div> <div> </div> <div>This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can both design the right treasury framework and make sure it operates effectively day to day. We are looking for candidates with real ownership experience in complex, multi-entity, multi-currency environments, ideally gained in energy, renewables, infrastructure, utilities or another project- and SPV-based business.</div> <div> </div> <div> <div><strong data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">About BW ESS</strong></div> <div>BW ESS is a global energy storage owner-operator, moving with speed to develop, deliver and operate market-leading projects. The business is active in the UK, Australia, Italy, Germany, Spain, and Sweden. It has more than 540MWh of operating Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), with ~12GWh under construction and a development pipeline of several gigawatts.</div> <div> </div> <div>Part of BW Group, BW ESS builds on decades of global infrastructure experience, takes a long-term view of projects and partnerships, and focuses on unlocking value throughout the energy storage asset lifecycle.</div>
